notes.title: protoViolence Patch 1.11
notes.content:
​Small bugfixes that account for the new Ren'Py update - among other things.

[list]
[*]     Fixed a text error in one of Deidre's diary entries.
[*]     Fixed window display issues for Deidre's diary entries
[*]     Fixed speechbubble display issues throughout the visual novel
[*]     Edited the phone dismiss transition. Unfortunately, I couldn't preserve the original transition, so it simply disappears when dismissed.
[/list]

notes.title: protoViolence's Anniversary Voice Update is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wzshxzeY0iU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Happy Anniversary, [i]protoViolence[/i]![/b]

Dr. Tan's and Shriya's voices are now implemented into the game. Please enjoy this enhanced [i]protoViolence[/i] experience.

And if you haven't played the game yet... take this free update as a sign to give my scifi VN a shot! 

All the best,

-Mado
